data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.875em; text-align:center; font-size:15px;"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Kitesurfing Guimaras is the first established Kite Center &amp; Kitesurf School in Guimaras Island, Philippines</span></span><br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
&nbsp;</p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.875em; text-align:center; font-size:15px;"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">We have been operational since 2018 and&nbsp;</span><span class="color_37 wixui-rich-text__text"><a href="https://www.vdws.de/en/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener" class="wixui-rich-text__text">we are an approved VDWS Kitesurfing Center!</a></span></span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.875em; text-align:center; font-size:15px;"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.875em; text-align:center; font-size:15px;"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">We offer Kitesurfing Courses / lessons for all kinds of levels. From Beginner to Advanced to Jumping and Looping.<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
The beach is the Secret Kite Spot in the Philippines.<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
No other Kite School around!</span></span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.875em; text-align:center; font-size:15px;"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Our Kitespot / beach is inside the Kite Resort. We keep our uncrowded spot exclusive for our guests from the resort.<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
&nbsp;</span></span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.875em; text-align:center; font-size:15px;"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">We have perfect steady winds and shallow warm water.&nbsp;<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
Beginner and Freestyler love the flat water of the lagoon and Freerider and Surfer love the Open Water with nice medium waves. at our reef.</span></span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.875em; text-align:center; font-size:15px;"><br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">The Kite School is open November 1. until April 1.</span></span><br class="wixui-rich-text__text">

<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">

It cannot be easier to start with Kitesurfing!</span></span></p>

id="comp-js5hjh0y2" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-js5hjh0y2 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_2 wixui-rich-text__text" style="text-align:center; font-size:40px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:40px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Weather&nbsp;</span></span></h2></div><div id="comp-jsd781ev" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-jsd781ev wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.875em; text-align:center; font-size:15px;"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Weather in Guimaras Island - Philippines is divided into 2 seasonal weather patterns:</span></span><br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
&nbsp;</p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.875em; text-align:center; font-size:15px;"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">Amihan (cool northeast or east wind)<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
and<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
Habagat (west or southwest wind).</span></span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.875em; text-align:center; font-size:15px;">&nbsp;</p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.875em; text-align:center; font-size:15px;"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">The Amihan season is characterized by moderate temperatures with little or no rainfall and a prevailing wind from the north-east / east. Amihan season is roughly from November to April. This is also known as the Kite Season.</span></span></p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.875em; text-align:center; font-size:15px;">&nbsp;</p>

<p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1.875em; text-align:center; font-size:15px;"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text">The Habagat season, on the other hand, is marked with hot and humid weather, along with frequent rainfall and a prevailing wind from the west / south-west. Habagat season falls around May to October.&nbsp;</span></span></p></div><div class="comp-jsd7ox1c mu5PoX" id="comp-jsd7ox1c" aria-disabled="false"><a data-testid="linkElement"
